Seasons

Northern Territory floodplain rivers

March and April broadly; some Kakadu offers extend into May.

  • Source 1
  • Source 2

Northern Territory, Australia

Barramundi can be caught in all four local fishing seasons. Access and conditions vary between the wet season, run-off, dry season and build-up.
